name: A goal, a win state and a chapter progression
body: The streets have no end. Add a `goal` world kind: reaching it completes the level (a message with the gem count), and after a few seconds the game loads the level named by the goal's `next_level` property, or returns to the main menu when it has none. The streets lead into `streets-later`, so a first playthrough runs from chapter 1 to chapter 3 and ends. Gentle: nothing is lost by finishing, and the level can be replayed from the menu.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, for slice 4, from the coordinator's request to keep growing the platformer.

acceptance_criteria: Reaching the streets' goal shows the completion message and loads the next level
The last level's goal returns to the main menu
A headless keyboard test walks from the last checkpoint to the goal and into the next level
